attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.file_id AS file_path FROM code.imports i JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = i.imported_file_id WHERE i.is_internal AND i.file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND i.imported_file_id IN (SELECT imported_file_id FROM code.imports WHERE file_id = 'httpx/_models.py' AND is_internal AND imported_file_id IS NOT NULL) AND i.imported_file_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY file_path
